title: The global alpha augmentation preserves cycles
statement: Let X be any scheme, U any family of opens, I an injective resolution of X.etaleAdditiveSheaf, n a natural number, and s a cycle of additiveCechGlobal I in degree n. There is a cycle t_alpha of additiveCechTotal U I such that its inclusion is additiveCechAlpha U I n applied to the inclusion of s. No covering, finiteness, compactness or separatedness assumption is needed.

source.place: Lemma 20.11.2, the alpha map of complexes; also the augmentation diagram of Tag 01FD.

proof.text: Define a(q) to restrict a global section of I^q to every singleton tuple. Postcomposing a(n) with either pairwise Cech face yields the same restriction to the pairwise intersection. The two alternating terms cancel, so the horizontal differential is zero.

Naturality of I.d identifies the vertical differential after a(n) with the global differential followed by a(n+1). The global cycle inclusion followed by the global differential is zero. Expand total_d, iota_D1, iota_D2: in horizontal degree zero both signs are +1, so the total differential vanishes.
Apply HomologicalComplex.liftCycles to iCycles followed by alpha, then evaluate at s. liftCycles_i gives exactly the required inclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem additiveCech_alpha_representative
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (I : InjectiveResolution X.etaleAdditiveSheaf) (n : ℕ)
    (s : (additiveCechGlobal I).cycles n) :
    ∃ tα : (additiveCechTotal U I).cycles n,
      (additiveCechTotal U I).iCycles n tα =
        additiveCechAlpha U I n ((additiveCechGlobal I).iCycles n s)
